causal_case.counterfactual_program:
(rule!
  (let* ((aobjs (objects g 0)) (bobjs (objects g 0)) (k 3))
    (define (num color) (length (filter (lambda (o) (and (= (obj-color o) color) (>= (obj-size o) k))) bobjs)))
    (let* ((counts (map num (list 1 2 3))) (ww (apply max (cons 1 counts))))
      (grid-from-fn 3 ww
        (lambda (r c) (if (< c (list-ref counts r)) (+ r 1) 0))))))
causal_case.program:
(rule!
  (let* ((objs (objects g 0))
         (blue-components (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 1)) objs))
         (k (length blue-components)))
    (define (count-selected color)
      (length (filter (lambda (o)
                        (and (= (obj-color o) color)
                             (>= (obj-size o) k)))
                      objs)))
    (let* ((n1 (count-selected 1))
           (n2 (count-selected 2))
           (n3 (count-selected 3))
           (ww (max 1 n1 n2 n3)))
      (grid-from-fn 3 ww
        (lambda (r c)
          (let ((cnt (cond [(= r 0) n1] [(= r 1) n2] [else n3]))
                (color (+ r 1)))
            (if (< c cnt) color 0)))))))
